items.source: Add ThreadPoolTaskExecutorCustomizers that should be applied to the ThreadPoolTaskExecutor.
items.translation: 添加 ThreadPoolTaskExecutorCustomizers，该自定义器应应用于 ThreadPoolTaskExecutor。

items.source: Set the ThreadPoolTaskExecutorCustomizers that should be applied to the ThreadPoolTaskExecutor.
items.translation: 设置要应用于 ThreadPoolTaskExecutor 的 ThreadPoolTaskExecutorCustomizers。

items.source: Set the TaskDecorator to use or null to not use any.
items.translation: 将 TaskDecorator 设置为使用，或设置为 `null` 以不使用任何装饰器。

items.source: Utilities and classes related to task execution and scheduling.
items.translation: 与任务执行和调度相关的实用工具和类。

items.source:
Set whether to accept further tasks after the application context close phase has
begun.
items.translation: 设置是否在应用程序上下文关闭阶段开始后接受更多任务。

items.source: Set whether core threads are allowed to time out.
items.translation: 设置是否允许核心线程超时。

items.source:
Set whether the executor should wait for scheduled tasks to complete on shutdown,
not interrupting running tasks and executing all tasks in the queue.
items.translation: 设置执行器在关闭时是否等待已调度的任务完成，不中断正在运行的任务并执行队列中的所有任务。

items.source: Set the maximum time the executor is supposed to block on shutdown.
items.translation: 设置执行器在关闭时应该阻塞的最大时间。

items.source: Set the core number of threads.
Set the time limit for which threads may remain idle before being terminated.
items.translation: 设置线程在空闲后被终止之前可以保持空闲的时间限制。

items.source: Set the maximum allowed number of threads.
items.translation: 设置允许的最大线程数。

items.source: Set the capacity of the queue.
Set the prefix to use for the names of newly created threads.
items.translation: 设置用于新创建线程名称的前缀。
